pages.text: Lamps are a long term source of light. They burn liquid fuel. Lamps retain their fuel content when broken. Using a bucket, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() on a lamp to add fuel to it. It can then be lit with a $(thing)firestarter$() or anything capable of lighting fires. $(thing)Olive Oil$() and $(thing)Tallow$() are lamp fuels. Shooting a lit lamp with an arrow can cause a fire.
Lamps are smithed in the $(l:mechanics/anvils)Anvil$() and crafted with $(l:mechanics/glassworking_applications#lamp_glass)Lamp Glass$() to be completed.
One lamp fuel is $(thing)Olive Oil$(). The first step in its production is to make olive paste.

Boil the $(thing)Olive Paste$() with $(thing)Water$() in a $(l:mechanics/pot)Pot$() to make $(thing)Olive Oil Water$(). Seal that in a $(l:mechanics/barrels)Barrel$() with your $(thing)Jute Net$() to produce $(thing)Olive Oil$(). Olive oil burns for 8 in-game hours for every unit of fluid.

Another lamp fuel is $(thing)Tallow$(). To make it, cook 5 $(thing)Blubber$(), in a $(l:mechanics/pot)Pot$() of water. Tallow burns for less than 2 in-game hours per unit. It can be used to make $(l:mechanics/lighting#candles)Candles$()

pages.name: Lampy lawowe
pages.text: Lawa będzie płonęła cały czas, ale może być przechowywana tylko w lampach z $(l:mechanics/stal#blue_steel)niebieskiej stali$().
$(thing)Łańcuchy$() świetnie nadają się do wieszania lamp i można je wykuć na $(l:mechanics/anvils)kowadle$().
